name: react-component-library.capture-story
purpose: Capture each requested immutable story directly in RCL’s isolated Browser Automation Studio harness at the requested viewport and theme.

asset_id.description: Catalog asset id, for example primitives.text.

version.description: Immutable version; defaults to the component manifest latest.

stories.description: Exact story ids to execute in the isolated version-pinned harness; defaults to every story in the versioned story contract.

assumptions: The selected immutable version has one validated story contract and its component manifest has a libraryId.
The current RCL API port is read from vrooli/scenario/status; a missing or invalid port prevents capture.
browser-automation-studio owns navigation, readiness, durable screenshots, and computed DOM evidence.
Story captures use an isolated harness and a versioned baseline namespace distinct from historical full-sheet images.
invariants: Every requested story x viewport x theme combination is represented in the envelope and targets exactly one isolated story harness.
A combination is ok only when its readiness marker is passed and captured DOM confirms the requested story id.
A failed or partial capture is never stored as a baseline.
The envelope is printed exactly once.
The command does not mutate library source or version content.

signals.combinations: one isolated story result per story x viewport x theme
signals.changed_count: later combinations whose normalized result changed

outputs.evidence: BAS execution identity, requested harness URL, story readiness/result identity, screenshot/DOM artifacts, and isolated-story baseline keys
